title: Milei Fires Olivos Residence Staff Over Leaks, Hands Control to Military
detail: President Milei fired roughly a dozen civilian staff at the Quinta de Olivos presidential residence following a series of internal leaks, La Nación reported. Military officials from the Casa Militar will take over day-to-day management of the residence within 60 days, and the government body that previously oversaw the property will be eliminated. Officials cited heightened global security concerns and preparations for Pope Leo XIV's expected November 2026 visit to Argentina as reasons for the shake-up.

media.caption: Report: Milei fires presidential residence staff over security

title: Milei's Draft 2027 Budget Earmarks $3.5B for Navy Submarines and Frigates
detail: Milei's draft 2027 national budget included a plan to reequip the Navy, earmarking roughly $2.3 billion in loans for three conventional submarines and $1.2 billion for two multi-purpose frigates — Argentina's first submarine purchase since the November 2017 loss of the ARA San Juan and its 44-member crew. The proposal must clear a Congress where Milei's La Libertad Avanza lacks a majority and will be debated through October alongside the government's 4% growth assumption for next year, amid heightened tensions with the UK over the Falklands and with Chile.

media.caption: Milei's budget for 2027 contemplates the purchase of three conventional submarines and two frigates
